import json
pairs=[{"input":G['Demo pair 1 input'],"output":G['Demo pair 1 output']},
       {"input":G['Demo pair 2 input'],"output":G['Demo pair 2 output']}]

def transform(grid):
    # remove uniform rows and columns
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({r[j] for r in grid})==1]
    g=[[v for j,v in enumerate(r) if j not in cols] for i,r in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])//2
    top=[r[:w] for r in g[:h//2]]; bot=[r[w:] for r in g[h//2:]]
    # shared color
    from collections import Counter
    cs=set(v for r in top for v in r); bs=set(v for r in bot for v in r)
    shared=(cs&bs).pop()
    out=[[3 if a==shared and b==shared else shared for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(top,bot)]
    return out

for p in pairs:
    o=transform(p['input'])
